exposure: Glycated albumin (GA) levels in the third trimester
cohort: The study included 819 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who underwent prenatal examinations and child delivery.
finding: Glycated albumin (GA) levels in the third trimester were significantly associated with specific adverse pregnancy outcomes, particularly premature rupture of membranes (PROM) and neonatal hypoglycemia.
